articles.title: Monte Carlo (TOPAS) characterization of a proton therapy OBI: Automated source parameter optimization and analysis of CBCT acquisition dynamics
articles.summary: This study demonstrates an automated framework for developing high-fidelity Monte Carlo beam models using standard CTDI measurements. The method provides an accessible alternative for characterizing On-Board Imaging (OBI) systems in proton therapy with high dosimetric accuracy.

articles.title: Unsupervised deep learning model for fast energy layer pre-selection of delivery-efficient proton arc therapy plan optimization of nasopharyngeal carcinoma
articles.summary: This study explores an unsupervised deep learning approach to optimize energy layer pre-selection in proton arc therapy. The model aims to improve treatment delivery efficiency by reducing energy layer switching time while maintaining plan quality for nasopharyngeal carcinoma.

articles.title: Dose-time-response relationships between radiation dose to the circulating blood and temporal changes in peripheral blood biomarkers during chemoradiation of non-small cell lung cancer
articles.summary: This research analyzes the relationship between radiation exposure to circulating blood and hematological toxicity in lung cancer patients. The findings support the need to minimize blood dose during radiotherapy to reduce treatment-related side effects.

articles.title: Comparison of dose escalation strategies for head and neck cancer patients using a radiobiological model of reoxygenation
articles.summary: This study evaluates different strategies for dose escalation to address tumor hypoxia in head and neck cancers. It provides a radiobiological model to quantify the limitations of dose-escalation approaches in a dynamic tumor environment.

articles.title: Mechanism of endothelial cell-derived S100A11 in promoting radiation-induced cardiac fibrosis in C57BL/6 mice
articles.summary: This study investigates the biological pathways behind radiation-induced cardiac fibrosis. Researchers identified S100A11 as a key mediator in endothelial cells following high-dose thoracic irradiation in a murine model.

articles.title: Trends of radiotherapy for hepatocellular carcinoma in the Republic of Korea: a national cohort, 2013-2021
articles.summary: This study analyzes the expansion of radiotherapy in the management of hepatocellular carcinoma, noting that while it has become a core component of multidisciplinary care, utilization remains geographically centralized. These findings highlight ongoing challenges in equitable access to radiation oncology infrastructure.

articles.title: Dosimetric impact of target volume anatomical parameters on radiotherapy after right-sided breast-conserving surgery
articles.summary: Researchers identified exploratory observational thresholds for target volume parameters associated with increased heart and lung dose risks in breast-conserving radiotherapy. The study emphasizes the need for prospective validation of these thresholds to improve clinical risk stratification and minimize radiation exposure to organs at risk.

articles.title: Gamification of clinical decision-making for medical physics residents
articles.summary: This article describes a new lecture series utilizing gamified clinical scenarios to support medical physics residency training. The framework covers essential topics such as patient safety, quality assurance, and treatment planning to enhance trainee clinical reasoning skills.

articles.title: PROton therapy for HPV-related oroPHaryngeal cancer patients using normal tissue complication probability (NTCP) modEl-based strategy: an iTalian multIcenter retrospective Cross-sectional study - PROPHETIC
articles.summary: This multicenter study evaluates the feasibility of using NTCP models to select patients for proton therapy. The results suggest that structured model-based evaluation is essential for consistent patient selection in head and neck cancer.

articles.title: Dynamic Range Modulation via Integrated Universal Range Shifter and Ridge Filter: Enabling Simplified Delivery for FLASH-Enabled IMPT
articles.summary: Researchers proposed a system combining universal range shifters and ridge filters to address challenges in achieving high dose rates for proton FLASH therapy. The approach aims to minimize energy layer switching interruptions to maintain the FLASH effect during Intensity Modulated Proton Therapy.

articles.title: Machine learning prediction of electronic-portal-imaging-device-based in vivo dosimetry results
articles.summary: This study developed a machine learning model to predict in vivo dosimetry results using EPID-based imaging and plan complexity metrics. The approach aims to provide a proactive method for risk anticipation in radiotherapy workflows before treatment delivery.

articles.title: Minimum recommended distances between cardiac implantable electronic devices and the applicator surface in low-energy intraoperative radiotherapy
articles.summary: This study establishes practical dosimetric guidelines for patients with cardiac implantable electronic devices undergoing intraoperative breast radiotherapy. Using ultrasound and applicator-specific distance metrics, researchers provided a framework to guide safer clinical treatment decisions.

articles.title: BayCare Proton Center Treats First Patient on Mevion S250 FIT™ with Leo Cancer Care's Marie® Solution
articles.summary: The BayCare Proton Center has successfully treated its first patient utilizing the Mevion S250 FIT™ system integrated with the Leo Cancer Care Marie® solution. This clinical milestone marks the implementation of new technology aimed at advancing patient positioning and treatment delivery in a proton therapy setting.

articles.title: 50 million Americans live in counties without a radiation oncology clinic, study finds
articles.summary: A recent study highlights that 50 million Americans reside in counties lacking a radiation oncology clinic, underscoring significant geographic disparities in access to cancer care. The findings emphasize the ongoing challenges in providing equitable radiation treatment coverage across the United States.

articles.title: ASTRO updates guideline on shorter-course radiation therapy for localized prostate cancer
articles.summary: The American Society for Radiation Oncology (ASTRO) has updated its clinical practice guidelines, providing new recommendations regarding the implementation of shorter-course radiation therapy regimens for localized prostate cancer. These guidelines aim to standardize care patterns and optimize treatment efficiency for patients.

articles.title: IBA treats first patient in clinical trial of FLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer
articles.summary: IBA has announced the treatment of the first patient in the C-FLASH-01 clinical trial, evaluating the safety and efficacy of ConformalFLASH proton therapy. This trial marks a significant milestone in testing ultra-high dose rate radiation delivery for head and neck cancer patients.

articles.title: Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute opens new wellness space
articles.summary: The Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute has inaugurated a new wellness facility dedicated to supporting patients and their caregivers. This regional development enhances the supportive care infrastructure at this key proton therapy center in the DMV area.

articles.title: Medicare change could cost standalone proton therapy centers millions
articles.summary: A proposed Medicare pricing change could significantly reduce reimbursement rates for standalone proton therapy centers compared to hospital-based departments. Stakeholders warn that this policy could negatively impact clinical operations and limit patient access to specialized cancer treatment.
